players.bio: Addison Barger (born November 12, 1999) is an American professional baseball infielder in the Toronto Blue Jays. He is ranked 14th on Major League Baseball's 2022 Top 30 Blue Jays prospects list. He was added to the 40-man roster following the 2022 season.

Alejandro Kirk (born November 6, 1998) is a Mexican professional baseball catcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He is ranked 6th on Major League Baseball's 2021 Top 30 Blue Jays prospects list.

Andrés Alfonso Giménez Osorio (born September 4, 1998) is a Venezuelan professional baseball second baseman for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Mets and Cleveland Guardians. He made his MLB debut in 2020 with the Mets.

Anthony Roger Santander (born October 19, 1994) is a Venezuelan professional baseball outfielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). Santander signed with the Cleveland Indians as an international free agent in July 2011. He made his professional debut in 2012 for the Arizona League Indians. From 2013 to 2015 he played for the Lake County Captains.
Robert Bowden Francis (born April 22, 1996) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2022.

Brandon Ivar Valenzuela (born October 2, 2000) is a Mexican professional baseball catcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2026. Career San Diego Padres Valenzuela signed with the San Diego Padres as an amateur free agent on July 2, 2017. While playing for the San Antonio Missions, he was named the Texas League's player of the month for June 2024.
Braydon Fisher (born July 26, 2000) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Brendon David Little (born August 11, 1996) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Chicago Cubs.
Brett Allen Bateman (born March 19, 2002) is an American professional baseball outfielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He debuted in MLB in 2026.

Charles Alexander McAdoo (born March 6, 2002) is an American professional baseball infielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2026. Amateur career McAdoo attended De La Salle High School in Concord, California and played college baseball at the San Jose State University.
Chase Alexander Lee (born August 13, 1998) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Detroit Tigers of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Cody Joe Ponce (born April 25, 1994) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). He played for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played college baseball for the Cal Poly Pomona Broncos. Ponce made his MLB debut in 2020.
Davis Schneider (born January 26, 1999) is an American professional baseball infielder and outfielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2023.

Dylan Edward Cease (born December 28, 1995) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the San Diego Padres of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Chicago White Sox. He made his MLB debut in 2019.

Ernie James Clement (born March 22, 1996) is an American professional baseball utility player for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has also played in MLB for the Cleveland Indians / Guardians and Oakland Athletics. Clement was selected by the Cleveland Indians in the fourth round of the 2017 MLB draft.

John Patrick Schneider (born February 14, 1980) is an American professional baseball coach who is the manager of the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He became a coach for the Blue Jays in 2019 and became interim manager on July 13, 2022. After the 2022 season, the Blue Jays hired him as their permanent manager.

José Orlando Berríos (born May 27, 1994), nicknamed "La Makina" (Spanish for "The Machine"), is a Puerto Rican professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He previously played for the Minnesota Twins, who selected him in the first round of the 2012 Major League Baseball draft.
José Soriano (born October 20,1998) is a Dominican Republic professional baseball pitcher for the Los Angeles Angels of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Josh Harris Smith (born August 7, 1997) is an American professional baseball infielder for the Texas Rangers of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2022. Amateur career Smith attended Catholic High School in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

Kazuma Okamoto (岡本 和真, Okamoto Kazuma; born June 30, 1996), is a Japanese professional baseball infielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants from 2015 to 2025, until moving to North America in 2026.

Louis Dennis Varland (born December 9, 1997) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Minnesota Twins of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2022. Career Varland attended North High School in North St. Paul, Minnesota and played college baseball at the Concordia University, St. Paul.
Mason Lynn Fluharty (born August 13, 2001) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Myles James Noble Straw (born October 17, 1994) is an American professional baseball center fielder for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Houston Astros and Cleveland Indians / Guardians. Straw was selected by the Astros in the 12th round of the 2015 Major League Baseball draft, and made his MLB debut with them in 2018.

Nathan Lukes (born July 12, 1994) is an American professional baseball outfielder in the Toronto Blue Jays. The Cleveland Indians selected Lukes in the seventh round of the 2015 Major League Baseball draft. After signing with the team he was assigned to the Mahoning Valley Scrappers, where he played in five games before missing the rest of the season after breaking his right hand.

Spencer Zane Arrighetti (born January 2, 2000) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Houston Astros of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2024. Amateur career Arrighetti attended Cinco Ranch High School in Katy, Texas, and played college baseball at TCU, Navarro College, and Louisiana.

Spencer David Miles (born July 26, 2000) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2026. Amateur career Miles attended Rock Bridge High School in Columbia, Missouri, and the University of Missouri, where he was a walk-on for the Missouri Tigers baseball team.

Trey David Yesavage (born July 28, 2003) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played college baseball for the East Carolina Pirates, and was selected by the Blue Jays in the first round of the 2024 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut in September 2025.

Tyler Scott Rogers (born December 17, 1990) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the San Francisco Giants of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played college baseball for Garden City Community College and Austin Peay State University. Rogers was drafted by the Giants in the 10th round of the 2013 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut in 2019.

Vladimir Guerrero Ramos Jr. (born March 16, 1999) is a Canadian-born Dominican professional baseball third baseman for the Toronto Blue Jays of Major League Baseball (MLB). He is the son of former MLB player and Hall of Famer Vladimir Guerrero Sr. He made his major league debut in April 2019.
